messages:
maya: Heads-up — exec escalation for Meridian Health pilot. CISO flagged our security questionnaire on retention & BYO-KMS, and pricing expectations for Dedicated don't match. Need coordinated unblock by EOD. @ajay @oliver @devon

devon: Which questions were flagged?

maya: Q22 retention, Q27 KMS/BYO, they want an audit-log sample. Pricing: they expected committed discount during trial; Sales Ops says discount applies post-contract.

ajay: I can draft answers and attach redacted logs. BYO-KMS is supported for Private but Dedicated in EU needs infra validation (~3-4w). Propose staged fallback: hosted keys + strict controls for pilot.

oliver: Finance can offer a provisional credit to mirror the expected trial discount for up to 30 days while terms are finalized. Needs RevOps approval. @sarah?

sarah: Confirmed — provisional credit works if AE files PO + trial scope. I'll prepare template.

maya: Uploading trial scope: https://redwood.internal/drive/meridian-trial-scope (10k req/day, retention 30d, expected 20% discount).

ajay: Draft reply snippet: "Retention: default 30d for pilot; expedited deletion certificate on request within 48h. Audit logs: sample attached (redacted). BYO-KMS: available for Private; Dedicated EU requires infra validation (~3-4w). Recommend hosted-key fallback for pilot with enhanced controls." Will attach logs in a sec.

devon: SE plan: canary routing (10% to Dedicated variant) + automatic fallback to Hosted if KMS/capacity not ready. Can prepare playbook tomorrow AM. Need customer allowlist IPs.

cto_jane: I can join the exec bridge tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Agree staged fallback. @oliver proceed with provisional credit outline for the briefing.

meera: I'll be backup on the exec call for security; available after 17:00 UTC.

sarah: PO template and provisional credit terms in progress. Maya, send final customer contact.

maya: Contacts: nate@meridian-health.com (CTO), ciso@meridian-health.com. Assignments: ajay -> questionnaire + logs by 16:00; devon -> canary playbook; sarah -> PO; oliver -> provisional credit terms; maya -> schedule exec brief and update customer.

deploy-bot: Reminder: add 'meridian-pilot' to allowlist once SE confirms IPs.

maya: Thanks everyone — locking exec bridge. If we need further escalation, @meera is primary security backup.

(End of thread)
